plan.goal: Size the binary .bed storage for a GWAS genotype dataset of 10567 samples and 8376135 variants, and report the per-chromosome file count and per-chromosome .bed size.
plan.rationale: PLINK binary .bed files pack 2 bits per sample per variant, so the whole-dataset size is n_samples × n_variants / 4 / 1e6 MB. The per-chromosome .bed size uses the same rule applied to the largest chromosome's variant count (680266). The number of per-chromosome files equals the number of chromosomes in the human reference genome (22 autosomes + X + Y + MT = 25), which is a structural count, not a computed value.
caveats: Per-chromosome file count (25) assumes a full human reference genome including sex chromosomes and mitochondrial DNA; if the dataset excludes X/Y/MT or uses a non-human reference, adjust the file count accordingly.
The per-chromosome .bed size is reported for the largest chromosome (680266 variants); other chromosomes will be smaller and should be sized individually if a per-file budget is needed.
Disk budget should include overhead for .bim/.fam files and any QC output, which are not included in the .bed size.
